title: 17 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Riverside Theater, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Riverside Theater in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA, on 17 October 2015.

It was the 29th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

Thank you Milwaukee you were amazing what a great time we all had at the gig peace and love thanks for your support ?????????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 18, 2015

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
